items.headline: Hollins throws 3 TD passes, South Alabama beats Louisiana-Monroe 52-35
items.description: — Jared Hollins threw for 321 yards and three touchdowns and South Alabama never trailed in a 52-35 win over Louisiana-Monroe on Saturday in a Sun Belt Conference opener.

items.headline: Baxter, Patterson and Barnes rush for 100 yards, Kentucky rolls over South Alabama 45-21
items.description: — CJ Baxter, Jason Patterson and Jovantae Barnes combined for 386 rushing yards and five touchdowns to power Kentucky to a 45-21 win over South Alabama on Saturday.
